column1: # Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Iceland (se.cautious, ruling R64): no national authority. Members: Diyanet's European
# method (subtask 7b's; the most followed) and Rabita Helsinki's family (se.rabita). Each member's tables where held,
# - Stockholm: Islamiska Förbundet's (IFIS, Diyanet Stockholm) December 2025-September 2026 pages and Diyanet's own
#   Stockholm table (September 2026-December 2027), both the member tr.diyanet.europe; their Fajr is also their imsak.
# - Helsinki: Rabita's 2026 calendar (se.rabita; 31 March left out, its Asr an hour off). Maghrib is not checked:
#   the members' Maghribs spread beyond 2 min and the cap follows the most-followed member, Diyanet, whose table is
# Every row is held out (a cautious entry has no margins of its own).
# - Helsinki and Copenhagen, Diyanet (the monitor round, brief D): Diyanet's own tables, the member tr.diyanet.europe
#   at its new units there; Maghrib is checked, the cap following Diyanet itself, the most-followed member.
# - The monitor round's fourteen Nordic tables (step c): Diyanet's own for Malmö, Aarhus, Aalborg, Göteborg, Uppsala, Turku,
#   Tampere, Sundsvall, Umeå, Oulu and Luleå, the member tr.diyanet.europe at its units there; Maghrib checked, the cap
# - Stockholm, Diyanet (the monitor's capture of 28 Sep 2026, the member tr.diyanet.europe): 29 Sep – 29 Oct 2026
#   and 2027; it adds 26–29 October to Diyanet's own Stockholm table above.
# - The monitor's captures are read from copies pinned as they were (archive/tables/pinned/tr-diyanet-europe/<date>/):
#   2026-09-28 for the rows above. The capture of 2 Oct 2026 (2026-10-02/) refreshed Stockholm, Helsinki and
#   Copenhagen (29 Sep – 1 Nov 2026 and 2027, the same minutes on every day both hold): a row each, as above; it
#   adds 30 October – 1 November. The other Nordic tables were not refetched.
